title: English Practice Quiz 0679
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: The hospital is ___ the bank and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for a position separating two things.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the apostrophe correctly?
options: The guards' uniform is blue. (one guard)
questions.explanation: Guard's shows possession by one guard.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use does + subject + base verb with he, she or it.

questions.question: Please drive ___.
questions.explanation: Carefully is the adverb modifying drive.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.
